sources.name: evodiff
sources.notes: Frozen D3PM uniform 38M sequence generator. Installed by setup --protein; model weights are downloaded separately by --prefetch-models.

sources.name: poli
sources.notes: Black-box interface for LaMBO-2. Installed only in the Python 3.10 environment by setup --lambo2.

sources.name: poli-baselines
sources.notes: LaMBO-2 adapter. Installed with --no-deps after the separately locked dependency closure; its upstream unpinned poli dependency must not replace this pin.

sources.name: holo-bench
sources.notes: The Holo DiscreteEvolution algorithm is adapted in src/baselines/holo_genetic_algorithm.py. Upstream source: holo/optim/_discrete_evolution.py. The adaptation adds finite paid budgets and prepaid initial labels; no external Holo installation is needed.

sources.name: flexs
sources.notes: AdaLead semantics are adapted in the sequence/protein proposal policy and src/sokoban/adalead_official.py. The retained no-recombination variant uses threshold parents, root-anchored rollout and a fixed surrogate-query budget. No FLEXS runtime installation is needed.

sources.name: ggs
sources.notes: GFP/AAV data and pretrained CNN fitness oracles. Use scripts/download_gfp_aav_sources.py for checksum-checked source downloads. Exact approved task splits and initial labels are supplied in the companion artifact bundle.

sources.name: boxoban-levels
sources.notes: Sokoban training levels. python -m sokoban.prepare --download validates ZIP SHA256 e2ca9eb749442c62c1f3b598df43b03b1849b299914ec9f6f6d6bf8a8ed693ed. Frozen generator and labelled initial boards are supplied in the companion artifact bundle.

sources.name: proteingym
sources.notes: The reference_files/DMS_substitutions.csv sequence mapping is used by scripts/prepare_gfp_aav_kermut_resources.py. Exact prepared GFP/AAV resources are supplied in the companion artifact bundle.

sources.name: kermut
sources.notes: The composite covariance is implemented in src/adapters/protein/kermut.py, with GenTuRBO constant mean and no optional zero-shot mean. The source archive revision was not recorded; no unverified revision is claimed. Reproduction uses the exact checksum-pinned prepared GFP/AAV NPZ resources in the companion bundle, not a download of the latest upstream data.

sources.name: esm
sources.notes: ESM2 mean-pooled protein embeddings. fair-esm 2.0.0 is pinned by the protein extra and lock. Prefetch uses esm2_t33_650M_UR50D including its contact-regression weights.
